full_judgment: 3. The case of the plaintiffs respondents, in short, is that the suit property originally belonged to Dhirendra Mohan Chowdhury, Niranjan Kumar Chowdhury and Monindra Kumar Thakur who acquired the property by inheritance and accordingly, record of right was prepared in their names. Dhirendra Mohan Chowdhury and Monindra Kumar Thakur died in the then East Pakistan and Niranjan Kumar Chowdhury left this country for India and their properties were made Khas under the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act.
